From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP (post-call recap)

Hi Sofia / Miguel —

Great call today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on stakeholders, timeline, and next steps. I attached a one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our SOC 2 summary (SOC2-Summary.pdf) for the security/procurement review.

Key stakeholders we captured on the call:
- Economic buyer: Miguel Torres (VP Product) — final approver for commercial terms and budget
- Security/legal: Lukas Meyer (you confirmed he’ll lead the security questionnaire)
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (estimating SOW + PO process)
- Technical champion: Sofia Ramirez — owns the integration and POC

Decision criteria we heard:
- 99th percentile latency and stable p95 under 750ms for inference workloads
- Cost per 1k tokens and ability to hit committed throughput (peak 10k req/day)
- SOC2 + audit trail / KMS support for keys

Proposed MAP & milestones (please confirm dates):
1) Technical deep dive + infra mapping (1.5 hrs) — week of Jun 8 (proposed: Jun 9)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — initial responses by Jun 10, follow-ups by Jun 17
3) Procurement: SOW draft & commercial redlines — Jun 18
4) Exec decision & PO — target by Jun 30

Requested next steps:
- Sofia: confirm tech-deep-dive slot (Jun 9 or Jun 10?) and any additional attendees from infra/legal
- Lukas: I’ll share the security questionnaire + SOC2 summary in this thread — can you confirm timeline for answers?
- Miguel/Procurement: any internal procurement milestones we should align to?

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SOC2-Summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP based on replies and share an updated file.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

- We should shift the technical deep dive to Jun 9 at 10am PT if that works for your team. I’ll invite our infra lead (Ana Gomez) and legal (cc: legal@finpay.com) to the meeting.
- Lukas: we’ll need the SOC2 details + any encryption/KMS notes for our security team to pre-scope. Can you target Jun 11 for the initial answers?
